description: Water Treatment Plant (WCORP-072) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Water Corporation. Water Corporation plant used for the management of water quality. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Water Corporation. Its tags are Water Corporation, treatment, water. It offers 8 resource(s) in api arcgis server map service, fgdb, geojson, geopackage, pdf. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Other). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
